{{Quote|During my time manning rigs on Subterrel, I'd occasionally use one of the low-volume mining sluices to prepare this tasty stew, made with ripe apple slugs, Ojomian onions, space-carrots and a pinch of negamo. Today, we make the stew more traditionally, in a pot on a nanowave stove, but it's just as flavorful as ever.|Dex's Diner menu, on its apple slug stew|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''mining sluice''' was a device used for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] on the astronomical object [[Subterrel/Legends|Subterrel]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Subterrel Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Subterrel system]]</ref> While working on Subterrel, the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used a low-volume mining sluice to prepare [[apple slug stew]]. He later shared his history of preparing the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] on the menu of his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Menu" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Coruscant Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Coruscant system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mining sluices were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
